nodes.text:
Gujarat reported its first case of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in a two-month-old boy from Dungarpur, Rajasthan. The infant is stable and under isolation. This brings India's total to three confirmed HMPV cases, with two earlier cases in Bengaluru.
